newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch pay tribute to China's Deng Xiaoping.
newsitem.headline: Dutch pay tribute to China's Deng Xiaoping.

text.p: The Dutch government on Wednesday paid tribute to China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, calling him a striking personality who engineered a radical transformation of the Chinese economy.
"His passing away will be felt as a great loss in China," the foreign ministry said in a brief statement responding to an official announcement of the 92-year-old leader's death.
It said the "open door policy" pursued by Deng Xiaoping when he came to power in 1978 had resulted in China's dynamic economic development.
"He broke with the isolationist policy pursued by China and ensured the country became more closely involved with the international community," the statement said.
A government spokesman said that as yet there was no statement available from the Dutch government in its role of European Union president.
